digest.component_or_area: Git version floor enforcement and merge-tree test gating
propositions: Git 2.38+ capability (merge-tree --write-tree) was not explicitly declared or enforced, leaving contributor and CI floor undefined
The two-clone enrichment regression for bug 8185 depends on git merge-tree --write-tree but had no version guard or skip logic, risking silent test omission
Session-level enforcement via pytest_configure aborts the entire test run if Git floor is not met, preventing vacuous skip guards that silently omit regression coverage
Git version floor is single-sourced in .github/git-version-floor.txt and enforced consistently across contributor docs (README, CONTRIBUTING, local-dev-env.md) and CI workflow
The 8185 regression test still executes on all gating CI environments (ubuntu-latest, macos-latest) and locally without skip or xfail paths
Non-vacuity guards fail-closed if merge-tree regression moves or is removed, and if an under-floor skip guard is ever added
